newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: CSR says timber not a big profit earner.
newsitem.headline: CSR says timber not a big profit earner.

text.p: Building products, aluminiun and sugar producer CSR Ltd said on Monday its timber division would not be a big profit earner for the next two years.
CSR Chairman Alan Coates told the group's annual meeting that conditions remained difficult for its timber business.
"It's not going to be a big profit earner for a year or two," Coates told the meeting.
He said the unit continued to be a core business and CSR hoped to improve profits over time by increasing the use of technology to improve productivity.
"There's no reason over time why, given the world price recovers, it can't be a good business for the company," he said.
Coates said CSR's attempts last year to sell its timber business had been unsuccessful because potential buyers were unwilling to buy it as a whole and instead wanted to "pick the eyes out of it".
CSR Timber is Australia's largest manufacturer and marketer of timber products and the country's only fully integrated timber producer.
The timber division made a net profit of A$4.10 million for theyear to March 31, 1996, down from A$25.2 million the previous year.
